peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the strain of Newcastle disease?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Newcastle disease (ND) is caused by virulent strains of avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1) of the genus Orthoavulavirus belonging to the subfamily Avulavirinae, family Paramyxoviridae.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What type of virus is Newcastle disease?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Newcastle disease is a severe, systemic, and fatal viral disease of poultry due to virulent strains of avian paramyxovirus type 1. Clinical signs in unvaccinated birds include sudden death, lethargy, and respiratory distress.
